title: transit: prepend_path_header drops blank body lines in LF-only articles
description: ingestion.rs:185-187: the body loop skips ALL empty slices (if line.is_empty() { continue }), intending to skip only the trailing empty slice that split() yields for input ending with '\n'. For LF-only articles any blank line in the body (empty line = empty slice) is incorrectly dropped. CRLF articles are unaffected (blank lines produce b"\r" which is non-empty). Fix: pre-collect slices, trim the trailing empty one, then remove the skip entirely from the body loop.
